args.title: Tamarack warehouse automation (2026) — combined summary
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece at https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion (unlocked via registration with marcus.okafor@northwind.example).
